create_aggregate_context: create a named aggregation context to collect and aggregate metrics during training or validation
log_scalar_values: log a scalar value like loss or accuracy into all active metrics aggregators with optional weight
log_derived_metric: log a derived metric computed from other meters using a callable function
log_speed_meter: log the rate of a quantity per second using a time-based meter for throughput tracking
get_smoothed_values: get all smoothed metric values aggregated under a given name like train or valid
